content: HM as NixOS module -> profiles build with nixos-rebuild; standalone -> home-manager switch on non-NixOS. NixOS module: useGlobalPkgs=true (HM uses system pkgs; overlays at system level), useUserPackages=true (profile /etc/profiles). Standalone requires explicit pkgs (nixpkgs.legacyPackages.<system>) and home.stateVersion mandatory in both. Shared module tree + thin per-kind wrapper yields identical user config across host types.
